<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

Record raw scientific data in catalogs, organize it and push it to the Huron share.

## Usage

```text
huron [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Every command also takes `--help`, which prints the same reference in the terminal.

## Global options

| Option           | Type                  | Default | Description                                     |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `--output`, `-o` | table \| json \| yaml | `table` | The output format: `table`, `json` or `yaml`.   |
| `--api-url`      | str                   |         | Use this API URL instead of the configured one. |
| `--catalog`      | str                   |         | Resolve identifiers against this catalog.       |

## Commands

### [Catalog](/docs/reference/cli/panels/catalog/)

| Command                                     | Description                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`org`](/docs/reference/cli/org/)           | List the organizations that you can see and mark the current one, or select one.       |
| [`catalog`](/docs/reference/cli/catalog/)   | List the catalogs of the current organization and mark the current one, or select one. |
| [`get`](/docs/reference/cli/get/)           | List organizations, catalogs, namespaces, collections and other resources.             |
| [`describe`](/docs/reference/cli/describe/) | Show the details of one organization, catalog, namespace, collection or schema.        |
| [`tree`](/docs/reference/cli/tree/)         | Show the namespace tree of the current catalog, with its collections as leaves.        |
| [`search`](/docs/reference/cli/search/)     | Search the current catalog by text, labels and state.                                  |
| [`checkout`](/docs/reference/cli/checkout/) | Make a collection the current working copy. Other working copies keep their stage.     |

### [Collection](/docs/reference/cli/panels/collection/)

| Command                                     | Description                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`status`](/docs/reference/cli/status/)     | Show where you are, and the staged changes and drift of the current collection. |
| [`add`](/docs/reference/cli/add/)           | Stage local files for the next push.                                            |
| [`rm`](/docs/reference/cli/rm/)             | Unstage an add or a removal, or stage the removal of a recorded file.           |
| [`pull`](/docs/reference/cli/pull/)         | Update the working copy to the version on the service.                          |
| [`push`](/docs/reference/cli/push/)         | Upload the staged files and commit them.                                        |
| [`edit`](/docs/reference/cli/edit/)         | Edit the metadata draft of a collection.                                        |
| [`validate`](/docs/reference/cli/validate/) | Check a metadata draft against its schema.                                      |
| [`publish`](/docs/reference/cli/publish/)   | Publish a metadata draft.                                                       |
| [`activate`](/docs/reference/cli/activate/) | Activate a draft collection.                                                    |

### [Manage](/docs/reference/cli/panels/manage/)

| Command                                 | Description                                                                        |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`create`](/docs/reference/cli/create/) | Create an organization, catalog, namespace or collection.                          |
| [`delete`](/docs/reference/cli/delete/) | Delete an empty organization, catalog or namespace, or a collection and its files. |
| [`set`](/docs/reference/cli/set/)       | Set the schema override of a collection, or the settings of a namespace.           |
| [`unset`](/docs/reference/cli/unset/)   | Clear the schema override of a collection.                                         |

### [Administration](/docs/reference/cli/panels/administration/)

| Command                           | Description                                                                 |
| --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`adm`](/docs/reference/cli/adm/) | Run administration tasks: roles, directory modes, drift checks and schemas. |

### [Settings](/docs/reference/cli/panels/settings/)

| Command                                 | Description                                                      |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`login`](/docs/reference/cli/login/)   | Log in with the institutional identity provider.                 |
| [`logout`](/docs/reference/cli/logout/) | Delete the stored tokens.                                        |
| [`whoami`](/docs/reference/cli/whoami/) | Show who you are, your LDAP groups and the roles that they hold. |
| [`config`](/docs/reference/cli/config/) | Show or change the CLI configuration.                            |
